facts.claim: In 1654, Kempe Cauda of Magadi suffered a defeat at Yelahanka by Kanthirava Narasa Raja, resulting in heavy losses and a forced contribution.
facts.quote: In 1654 Kempe Cauda of Magadi had been defeated at Yelahanka by Kanthirava Narasa Raja with great loss and forced to pay a contribu- tion.

facts.claim: Venkoji decided to sell Bangalore to the highest bidder because he considered it an expensive and precarious possession.
facts.quote: He therefore determined to sell it to the highest bidder, and Chikka Deva Raja, who, taking advantage of the general anarchy, had been gradually extending his possessions, finally agreed to purchase it for three lakhs of rupees

facts.claim: In July 1687, Bangalore officially became part of the Mysore kingdom.
facts.quote: Thus, in July 1687, this important town became a part of the Mysore kingdom.
